title.value: Prognosis of critically ill immunocompromised patients with virus‐detected acute respiratory failure
title.justification: The title directly indicates the paper's focus on the prognosis of immunocompromised patients with virus-detected ARF.
title.quote: Prognosis of critically ill immunocompromised patients with virus‐detected acute respiratory failure

analysis.description: This research paper investigates the prognosis of immunocompromised patients admitted to the intensive care unit with acute respiratory failure where a virus is detected. The study examines factors impacting mortality and compares virus-detected ARF with ARF from other etiologies, using data from a multicenter cohort study.

type.justification: The research involves the analysis of a large multi-center cohort dataset to draw empirical conclusions about virus-detected ARF in immunocompromised patients.
type.quote: We used the Groupe de Recherche en Réanimation Respiratoire en Onco-Hématologie’s database (2003–2017, 72 intensive care units) to describe the spectrum of critically ill immunocompromised patients with virus-detected ARF and to report their outcomes.

name.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on intensive care outcomes in immunocompromised patients, thus aligning with Intensive Care Medicine.
name.quote: Acute respiratory failure (ARF) is the leading cause of ICU admission.

name.justification: The research focuses on virus-detected acute respiratory failure, which involves virological analysis.
name.quote: Viruses are increasingly recognized as a cause of pneumonia in immunocompromised patients.

name.justification: The study analyzes epidemiological data from a cohort to assess the outcomes and prevalence of virus-detected ARF in the ICU.
